name: UnderlyingIndexAnnexSource
description: The source of a credit default swap index series annex.

name: UnderlyingProductComplex
description: Identifies an entire suite of products for a given market. In Futures this may be "interest rates", "agricultural", "equity indexes", etc

name: UnderlyingSecurityGroup
description: An exchange specific name assigned to a group of related securities which may be concurrently affected by market events and actions.

name: UnderlyingSettleOnOpenFlag
description: Indicator to determine if Instrument is Settle on Open.

name: UnderlyingAssignmentMethod
description: Method under which assignment was conducted

name: UnderlyingSecurityStatus
description: Indicates the current state of the underlying instrument.

name: UnderlyingObligationType
description: Type of reference obligation for credit derivatives contracts.

name: UnderlyingAssetClass
description: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure.

name: UnderlyingAssetSubClass
description: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

name: UnderlyingAssetType
description:
Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in UnderlyingAssetSubClass(2082).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed.
Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

name: UnderlyingSwapClass
description: The type or classification of swap. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

name: UnderlyingNthToDefault
description: The Nth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. If specified without UnderlyingMthToDefault(2018) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If UnderlyingMthToDefault(2018) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

name: UnderlyingMthToDefault
description: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When UnderlyingNthToDefault(2017) and UnderlyingMthToDefault(2018) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

name: UnderlyingSettledEntityMatrixSource
description: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

name: UnderlyingSettledEntityMatrixPublicationDate
description: Specifies the publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. If not specified, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

name: UnderlyingStrikeMultiplier
description: Used for derivatives. Multiplier applied to the strike price for the purpose of calculating the settlement value.

name: UnderlyingStrikeValue
description: Used for derivatives. The number of shares/units for the financial instrument involved in the option trade.

name: UnderlyingStrikePriceDeterminationMethod
description: Specifies how the strike price is determined at the point of option exercise. The strike may be fixed throughout the life of the option, set at expiration to the value of the underlying, set to the average value of the underlying , or set to the optimal value of the underlying.

values.meaning: Strike set at expiration to underlying or other value (lookback floating)
Strike set to average of underlying settlement price across the life of the option

name: UnderlyingStrikePriceBoundaryMethod
description: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the strike price relative to the underlying price at the point of option exercise.

values.meaning: Less than underlying price is in-the-money (ITM)
Less than or equal to the underlying price is in-the-money(ITM)
Equal to the underlying price is in-the-money(ITM)
Greater than or equal to underlying price is in-the-money(ITM)

name: UnderlyingStrikePriceBoundaryPrecision
description: Used in combination with StrikePriceBoundaryMethod(1479) to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

name: UnderlyingMinPriceIncrement
description: Minimum price increment for the instrument. Could also be used to represent tick value.

name: UnderlyingMinPriceIncrementAmount
description: Minimum price increment amount associated with the UnderlyingMinPriceIncrement(2026). For listed derivatives, the value can be calculated by multiplying UnderlyingMinPriceIncrement(2026) by UnderlyingContractMultiplier(436).

name: UnderlyingOptPayoutType
description: Indicates the type of valuation method or payout trigger for an in-the-money option.

name: UnderlyingOptPayoutAmount
description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an option. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

name: UnderlyingPriceQuoteMethod
description: Method for price quotation.

values.meaning: Standard, money per unit of a physical

name: UnderlyingValuationMethod
description: Indicates type of valuation method used.

values.meaning: futures style with an attached cash adjustment
CDS style collateralization of market to market and coupon
CDS in delivery - use recovery rate to calculate obligation

name: UnderlyingListMethod
description: Indicates whether the instruments are pre-listed only or can also be defined via user request.

name: UnderlyingCapPrice
description: Used to express the ceiling price of a capped call.

name: UnderlyingFloorPrice
description: Used to express the floor price of a capped put.

name: UnderlyingFlexibleIndicator
description: Used to indicate if a security has been defined as flexible according to "non-standard" means. Analog to CFICode Standard/Non-standard indicator.

name: UnderlyingFlexProductEligibilityIndicator
description: Used to indicate if a product or group of product supports the creation of flexible securities.

name: UnderlyingPositionLimit
description: Position limit for the instrument.

name: UnderlyingNTPositionLimit
description: Position Limit in the near-term contract for a given exchange-traded product.

name: UnderlyingPool
description: Identifies the mortgage backed security (MBS) / asset backed security (ABS) pool.

name: UnderlyingContractSettlMonth
description: Specifies when the contract (i.e. MBS/TBA) will settle. Must be present for MBS/TBA.

name: UnderlyingDatedDate
description: If different from IssueDate()

name: UnderlyingInterestAccrualDate
description: If different from IssueDate and DatedDate

name: UnderlyingRefTickTableID

name: UnderlyingComplexEventType
description: Identifies the type of complex event.

name: UnderlyingComplexOptPayoutAmount
description: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an event. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

name: UnderlyingComplexEventPrice
description: Specifies the price at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the UnderlyingComplexEventType(2046).

name: UnderlyingComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod
description: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the event price relative to the UnderlyingComplexEventPrice(2048) at the point the complex event outcome takes effect as determined by the UnderlyingComplexEventPriceTimeType(2051).

values.meaning: Less than or equal to ComplexEventPrice(1486)
Greater than or equal to ComplexEventPrice(1486)

name: UnderlyingComplexEventPriceBoundaryPrecision
description: Used in combination with UnderlyingComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod(2049) to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

name: UnderlyingComplexEventPriceTimeType
description: Specifies when the complex event outcome takes effect. The outcome of a complex event is a payout or barrier action as specified by the UnderlyingComplexEventType(2046).

name: UnderlyingComplexEventCondition
description: Specifies the condition between complex events when more than one event is specified.

name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventDates
description: Number of underlying complex event dates in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingComplexEventStartDate
description: The start date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options.

name: UnderlyingComplexEventEndDate
description: The end date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options.

name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventTimes
description: Number of complex event times in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingComplexEventStartTime

name: UnderlyingComplexEventEndTime
description: The end time of the time range on which a complex event date is effective.

name: LegEventTimeUnit

name: LegEventTimePeriod

name: NoLegSecondaryAssetClasses

name: LegSecondaryAssetSubClass
description: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

name: PreviousClearingBusinessDate
description: The date of the previous clearing business day.

name: ValuationDate
description: The valuation date of the trade.

name: ValuationTime
description: The valuation time of the trade.

name: ValuationBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center whose calendar is used for valuation, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: MarginAmtFXRate
description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the MarginAmt(1645) from the MarginAmtCcy(1646) and the Currency(15).

name: MarginAmtFXRateCalc
description: Specifies whether or not MarginAmtFXRate(2088) should be multipled or divided.

name: CollateralFXRate
description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the CurrentCollateralAmount(1704) from the CollateralCurrency(1646) and the Currency(15).

name: CollateralFXRateCalc
description: Specifies whether or not CollateralFXRate(2090) should be multipled or divided.

name: CollateralAmountMarketSegmentID
description: Market segment associated with the collateral amount.

name: CollateralAmountMarketID
description: Market associated with the collateral amount.

name: PayCollectFXRate
description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the PayAmount(1710) or CollectAmount(1711) from the PayCollectCurrency(1709) and the Currency(15).

name: PayCollectFXRateCalc
description: Specifies whether or not PayCollectFXRate(2094) should be multipled or divided.

name: PosAmtStreamDesc
description: Corresponds to the value in StreamDesc(40051) in the StreamGrp component.

name: PositionFXRate
description: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the PosAmt(708) from the PositionCurrency(1055) and the Currency (15).

name: PositionFXRateCalc
description: Specifies whether or not PositionFXRate(2097) should be multipled or divided.

name: PosAmtMarketSegmentID
description: Market segment associated with the position amount.

name: PosAmtMarketID
description: Market associated with the position amount.

name: TerminatedIndicator
description: Indicates if the position has been terminated.

name: ShortMarkingExemptIndicator
description: Indicates whether the originating account is exempt (Y) from marking orders as short or not (N). This designation may be used on both buy and sell orders.

name: RelatedRegulatoryTradeIDSource
description: Specifies the identifier of the reporting entity as assigned by regulatory agency.

name: NoAttachments
description: The number of attached files.

name: AttachmentName
description: Specifies the file name of the attachment.

name: AttachmentMediaType
description: The MIME media type (and optional subtype) of the attachment. The values used are those assigned, listed and maintained by IANA (www.iana.org) [RFC2046]. See http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/index.html for available types.

name: AttachmentClassification
description: Specifies semantically the type of the attached document from a business perspective. The default classification scheme reuses the FIX standard classification scheme of a high level section (pretrade, trade, posttrade, etc.) and a category, then a specific application or document type. The expression follows {"section/category/application type"}.

name: AttachmentExternalURL
description: Used to specify an external URL where the attachment can be obtained.

name: AttachmentEncodingType
description: The encoding type of the content provided in EncodedAttachment(2112).

name: UnencodedAttachmentLen
description: Unencoded content length in bytes. Can be used to validate successful unencoding.

name: EncodedAttachmentLen
description: Byte length of encoded the EncodedAttachment(2112) field.

name: EncodedAttachment
description: The content of the attachment in the encoding format specified in the AttachmentEncodingType(2109) field.

name: NoAttachmentKeywords
description: The number of attachment keywords.

name: AttachmentKeyword
description: Can be used to provide data or keyword tagging of the content of the attachment.

name: NegotiationMethod

description: Reference to the underlier whose payments are being passed through.

description: Specifies when the payout is to occur.

name: ComplexOptPayoutCurrency

name: ComplexEventPricePercentage
description: Specifies the price percentage at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the ComplexEventType(1484).

name: ComplexEventCurrencyOne
description: Specifies the first or only reference currency of the trade.

name: ComplexEventCurrencyTwo
description: Specifies the second reference currency of the trade.

name: ComplexEventQuoteBasis
description: For foreign exchange Quanto option feature.

name: ComplexEventFixedFXRate
description: Specifies the fixed FX rate alternative for FX Quantro options.

name: ComplexEventDeterminationMethod
description:
Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

name: ComplexEventCalculationAgent
description: Used to identify the calculation agent.

values.meaning: As specified in the master agreement
As specified in the standard terms supplement

name: ComplexEventStrikePrice
description: Upper strike price for Asian option feature. Strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

name: ComplexEventStrikeFactor
description: Strike factor for Asian option feature. Upper strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

name: ComplexEventStrikeNumberOfOptions
description: Upper string number of options for a Strike Spread.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventsXIDRef
description: Reference to credit event table elsewhere in the message.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventNotifyingParty
description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventBusinessCenter
description:
The local business center for which the credit event is to be determined. The inclusion of this business center implies that Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions is replaced by the local time of the specified business center.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventStandardSources
description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', indicates that ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventMinimumSources
description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.

name: ComplexEventXID
description: Identifier of this complex event for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

name: ComplexEventXIDRef
description: Reference to a complex event elsewhere in the message.

name: ValuationReferenceModel
description: Specifies the methodology and/or assumptions used to generate the trade value.

name: StrategyType
description: Specifies the type of trade strategy.

name: CommonPricingIndicator
description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that common pricing applies. Common pricing may be relevant for a transaction that references more than one commodity reference price.

name: SettlDisruptionProvision
description: Specifies the consequences of bullion settlement disruption events.

name: InstrumentRoundingDirection
description: Specifies the rounding direction if not overridden elsewhere.

name: InstrumentRoundingPrecision
description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

name: LegSettleOnOpenFlag
description: Indicator to determine if the instrument is to settle on open.

name: LegInstrmtAssignmentMethod
description: Specifies the method under which assignment was conducted.

name: LegSecurityStatus
description: Indicates the current state of the leg instrument.

name: LegRestructuringType
description: A category of CDS credit event in which the underlying bond experiences a restructuring.

name: LegSeniority
description: Specifies which issue (underlying bond) will receive payment priority in the event of a default.

name: LegNotionalPercentageOutstanding
description: Indicates the notional percentage of the deal that is still outstanding based on the remaining components of the index.

name: LegOriginalNotionalPercentageOutstanding
description: Used to reflect the Original value prior to the application of a credit event. See LegNotionalPercentageOutstanding(2151).

name: LegAttachmentPoint
description: Lower bound percentage of the loss that the tranche can endure.

name: LegDetachmentPoint
description: Upper bound percentage of the loss the tranche can endure.

name: LegObligationType
description: Type of reference obligation for credit derivatives contracts.

name: LegSwapSubClass
description: The sub-classification or notional schedule type of the swap.

name: LegNthToDefault
description: The Nth reference obligation in a CDS reference basket. If specified without LegMthToDefault(2158) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If LegMthToDefault(2158) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

name: LegMthToDefault
description: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When an NthToDefault(2157) to MthToDefault(2158) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

name: LegSettledEntityMatrixSource
description: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

name: LegSettledEntityMatrixPublicationDate
description: The publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. When this element is omitted, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

name: LegCouponType
description: Specifies the coupon type of the bond.

name: LegTotalIssuedAmount
description: Specifies the total amount of the issue. Corresponds to the par value multiplied by the number of issued security.

name: LegCouponFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: LegCouponFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: LegCouponDayCount
description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

name: LegConvertibleBondEquityID
description: Identifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted to.

name: LegConvertibleBondEquityIDSource
description: Identifies class or source of the LegConvertibleBondEquitySecurityID(2166) value.

description: Reference month if there is no applicable LegMaturityMonthYear(610) value for the contract or security.

name: LegLienSeniority
description: Indicates the seniority level of the lien in a loan.

name: LegLoanFacility
description: Specifies the type of loan when the credit default swap's reference obligation is a loan.

name: LegReferenceEntityType
description: Specifies the type of reference entity for first-to-default CDS basket contracts.
